resources.string: Only watches Instagram and YouTube, to detect when Reels or Shorts are opened and send you back out of them. When a Reel is opened from a DM, it reads the chat name so Reels sent in chats you allow can play. Other apps’ screens are never read (only which app is in front), no messages are read, and the app has no internet access, so nothing ever leaves your phone.
You asked Snoozy to keep them asleep, so you’ve been sent back.

Android will warn that this app gets \"full control\". It shows that warning for every accessibility app. Snoozy only looks at Instagram and YouTube. It reads the name of a DM chat only so Reels sent in your chats can play. It has no internet access, so nothing can leave your phone.
